name: LLM Agent Tools

specs.name: get_latest_defect
specs.description: This function makes an HTTP GET request to the backend to retrieve the most recent defect. The data includes information such as the defect type and an associated image.

specs.name: get_most_common_defect
specs.description: This function makes an HTTP GET request to the backend to retrieve the most common defect. The data includes information such as the defect type and the number of defects in that category and the total number of defects.

meta.description: Tools to aid the agentic AI assistant to answer user prompts
